image_title: Ablations on Tool Position and Training Robustness
summary: The image contains two bar charts and one line chart analyzing the impact of tool position and training robustness on accuracy gain. The line chart on the left shows the relationship between verified voting weight and accuracy gain for AIME and MATH, with notable gains of +31.6% and +2.2% respectively. The bar chart in the center compares tool calling versus verification relative to TTRL, highlighting a significant accuracy gain of +31.6% for TTRL-Agent in AIME, while AMC and MATH500 show negative gains. The bar chart on the right compares training robustness, showing higher variance for T3RL with a value of 6.959 compared to TTRL's 3.572. These visuals collectively illustrate the effects of different strategies on performance metrics.
